tasks.short: Read meters and analyse parts performance

steps.what: Read the actual dials and meters for amperage, voltage and electrical input and output at the specified operating temperature, checking the instrument, operating state and stable observation conditions.
inputs: actual instruments and part under test

steps.what: Write the actual readings, units, instrument and part references, time and operating temperature in the test worksheet.

Analyse the readings against the test specification in {SPREADSHEET}; configure native unit fields, approved comparison formulas and plots to reduce repeated arithmetic and layout, retaining manual entry, performance interpretation and the final check of the completed findings.
Save the checked final parts-performance findings in {SPREADSHEET}.

tasks.design: Configure the existing performance worksheet in {SPREADSHEET} with explicit units, approved formulas and plots. Reading physical meters and first capture stay manual; only repeated arithmetic and findings layout become shorter.
tasks.previous_blocker: The technician may rebuild comparisons for repeated performance readings.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas and plots can reuse explicit observed values.
tasks.still_hard: Unstable conditions, unreliable instruments and abnormal performance need technical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Notice a reading that does not represent the stated operating condition.

ambition.what: No automatic meter reading or equipment adjustment.

tasks.altitude: A small reduction in worksheet preparation; observation remains unchanged.

evidence.claim: Spreadsheet formulas and plots can reuse entered measurements without reading an analogue instrument or validating test conditions.

assumptions: Boundary is reading meters through analysis and the actual findings record, not changing the equipment or test setup. Shares are a conditional scenario.

The technician produces part/test ID, instrument ID, actual measurement name/value/unit, observation time and actual temperature in s1-s2. Manual capture and entry are fully counted. The engineer's test specification supplies the approved comparisons; missing or unstable readings are not filled automatically.

Try native worksheet formulas before code. Only the arithmetic and layout component of s3 loses time; interpretation and final checking remain. If already configured, no saving. No connected meter feed or extra report is assumed.

The ordinary final author check in s3 binds the completed findings for s4 under the requested commit gate. Edits require rechecking, with no added approval stage. The one-share save retains full time.
unknowns: Actual repeated calculation and layout effort
research_questions: Which performance calculations are still repeated manually after source readings are captured?

already_counted.description: Enter readings, interpret performance and check the completed findings.

approvals.approved_version: Final performance findings checked at the end of s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native arithmetic and layout remove 20% of the 24-hour analysis preparation share: 4.8 gross hours less 1 upkeep. Zero if formulas already exist. Physical reading, capture and save remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Examine the actual workpiece and manufacturing operation, review drawings and discuss tooling constraints under engineering direction to establish the fixture or tool requirements.

Design the mold, tool, die, jig or fixture appropriate to this job in mechanical CAD {OTHER}; use native parameterised standard features for repeated geometry while the technician chooses locating, access and support arrangements and checks the generated geometry.

Check the completed tool design against workpiece references, required tolerances, process access and engineering constraints, resolving design errors and recording unresolved engineering questions before saving the draft.
Save the checked final manufacturing-tool design draft in mechanical CAD {OTHER} under its existing draft status.

tasks.design: Configure approved standard-feature libraries in mechanical CAD {OTHER} for repeated tooling geometry. The technician retains workpiece investigation, tool decisions and the final design check under existing engineering direction.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated locating, support and drawing features can be rebuilt by hand for each tool.
tasks.enabler_now: Native parameterised features reuse explicit dimensions and references.
tasks.still_hard: Workholding, tolerances, access and manufacturing feasibility require design judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise that a reusable feature does not suit this particular workpiece or process.

ambition.what: Compare a second fixture arrangement where manufacturing access is uncertain.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated geometry construction; design remit remains unchanged.

reach.learn: Keep features and dimensions tied to workpiece revisions.

evidence.claim: Native CAD feature libraries can reuse parameterised tooling geometry without choosing a valid workholding design.

assumptions: Boundary is one manufacturing-tool design instance through its stored draft, not manufacturing or releasing the tool. A job uses the applicable tool type rather than designing all listed examples. Shares are illustrative.

The technician establishes workpiece/revision ID, datum references, required dimensions and tolerances, manufacturing operation and access constraints in s1. Manual measurement and clarification are counted there. In s2 the technician selects feature ID/version and enters explicit dimensions; missing inputs require manual design, not guessed geometry.

Native libraries precede code. The reduction is repeated geometric construction only; tool choice, generated geometry review and final substantive checking retain time. Zero if native features are already used.

The ordinary check of the completed design in s3 binds the requested s4 save gate without a new self-approval activity. Edits invalidate the check. Save retains its one-share time; engineering release is unchanged.
research_questions: Which tooling features repeat with explicit parameters while preserving workpiece revision references?

already_counted.description: Choose and review generated tooling geometry and check the final design.

incremental.description: Maintain approved tooling features and dimensional validation.

approvals.approved_version: Final manufacturing-tool design draft checked at the end of s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native features remove 30% of the 30-hour design construction share: 9 gross hours less 2 upkeep. Zero if already used. Workpiece investigation, final checking and save retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan fabrication, assembly and testing requirements

steps.what: Read the actual project instructions and specifications in {DOCS}, verify revisions and identify the fabrication, assembly and testing requirements and unclear clauses.

Determine the fabrication, assembly and testing plan under engineering direction, resolve unclear instructions and decide which requirements need a proposed modification or further engineering review.
outputs: technician-defined work plan and proposed modifications

steps.what: Prepare the plan and requirement-reference table in {PROJECT}; configure native requirement links and plan fields to reuse verified clause IDs and revisions, then check the completed plan, proposed modifications and unresolved decisions against the source instructions.
inputs: technician-defined work plan and proposed modifications
outputs: checked final fabrication assembly and test plan draft

steps.what: Save the checked final fabrication, assembly and test plan draft in {PROJECT}.
inputs: checked final fabrication assembly and test plan draft

tasks.design: Configure native requirement links and plan fields in {PROJECT} using the verified sources in {DOCS}. Reading technical meaning and planning the work stay human; repeated clause-reference and plan assembly become shorter.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plan documents can repeatedly copy requirement identifiers and source revisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native requirement links preserve explicit source references across plan fields.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous specifications and workable assembly or test sequences need engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Notice that a formally linked requirement has not actually been addressed by the plan.

ambition.what: No automatic change to an engineering specification.

tasks.altitude: Less reference-table maintenance, with planning responsibility unchanged.

reach.learn: Trace planned work and tests to actual technical clauses.

evidence.claim: Native requirement links can reuse clause and revision references while technical planning remains human.

assumptions: Boundary is reviewing and planning the project requirements through a stored plan draft, including proposed modifications. Authorising a specification change and performing fabrication or testing are separate. Shares are scenarios.

The technician identifies source document/version, clause ID, requirement wording and unresolved issue in s1, then produces actual proposed actions, dependencies, test intent and modification status in s2. Reading, tagging, clarification and plan choice are counted. Missing identifiers use manual references; no automatic semantic requirement extraction is assumed.

Try native requirement links before custom code. Only repeated reference copying and layout in s3 lose time, not reading, technical interpretation, dialogue or choosing the plan. Actual plan writing and final checking remain in s3's retained effort.

s3's ordinary completed-plan check supplies the requested s4 commit gate without an added approval step. Edits require rechecking. The one-share save earns no saving and does not authorise proposed changes.
research_questions: Can native plan links preserve unresolved changes and source revisions without implying approval?

already_counted.description: Write and check the plan with native requirement references.

incremental.description: Maintain requirement-link fields and revision checks.

approvals.approved_version: Final work-plan draft checked at the end of s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native reference and layout reuse removes 30% of the 24-hour plan preparation share: 7.2 gross hours less 1 upkeep. Zero if native links already exist. Source review, technical planning and save remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Discuss the specialised equipment need with engineering and users, inspect the actual installation interfaces and establish the functional and physical constraints.
Choose a proposed equipment concept, interfaces and component arrangement within the technician's engineering direction, identifying decisions that require an engineer's resolution.

Develop the customised equipment model and detail drawings in mechanical CAD {OTHER}; configure native standard component references and drawing views to reduce repeated component modelling and sheet construction, checking their fit to the chosen concept.

Review the completed customised design against functional needs, physical interfaces, manufacturability and engineering constraints, correcting errors and recording unresolved technical decisions before finalising the draft.
Save the checked final customised-equipment design draft in mechanical CAD {OTHER} with its actual draft status.

tasks.design: Configure native component references and drawing views in mechanical CAD {OTHER}. The technician determines the customised concept with engineers and users, then checks the resulting design rather than delegating equipment design choices.
tasks.previous_blocker: Standard components and drawing sheets can be remodelled for otherwise unique equipment.
tasks.enabler_now: Native references and views can reuse verified component geometry and dimensions.
tasks.still_hard: Novel interfaces, machine behaviour and manufacturing feasibility need engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a unique integration problem hidden behind familiar components.

ambition.what: Compare a second component arrangement when a customised installation has competing access constraints.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated component and sheet construction; engineering direction and release authority stay unchanged.

reach.learn: Make physical and control-interface assumptions explicit.

evidence.claim: CAD component references and native drawing views can reuse verified geometry without resolving a customised equipment concept.

assumptions: Boundary is a specialised equipment design through its stored draft. It is a distinct equipment project from the manufacturing-tool case in task 22077, so no shared action is claimed. Manufacturing, installation and release remain outside this design preparation. Shares are illustrative.

The technician produces equipment/project ID, actual interface dimensions and units, functional requirements and engineering constraints in s1. Physical inspection and manual capture are counted. In s2-s3 the technician chooses arrangement and component ID/version, verifies dimensions and enters their placement; missing data require manual clarification rather than inferred geometry.

Native component and view configuration precedes code. Only repeated model and sheet construction lose time. Unique concept development, discussion, inspection and final technical checking retain their time. No automatic machine-control code or operating action is introduced.

s4 is the ordinary completed-design check, supplying the requested s5 exact-version save gate without a new approval activity. Edits require rechecking. Save is one fully retained share; engineering release remains separate. Additional alternative demand is not counted as saving.
research_questions: Which standard components recur in customised designs without hiding unique interface constraints?

already_counted.description: Review referenced geometry and check the completed customised design.

incremental.description: Maintain component versions and drawing-view configuration.

approvals.approved_version: Final customised-equipment design draft checked at the end of s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native components and views remove 30% of the 25-hour model and drawing construction share: 7.5 gross hours less 1.5 upkeep. Zero if already configured. Inspection, concept decisions, final checking and save remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Mechanical engineering technicians retain physical observations and design judgement under engineering direction while native calculations, references and CAD features reduce repeated preparation.
reach: Trace tooling revisions with mechanical drafters
Clarify customised equipment interfaces with mechatronics engineers
role.ambitious_version: Prepare traceable engineering drafts and comparisons without treating reusable geometry as a substitute for technical judgement.
